items.title: GR00T 2 learns skills from human video and runs them on robots that never practiced them
items.excerpt: GR00T 2 predicts the next few seconds of video before it moves. A robot running it learns skills from human demonstrations, then carries those skills to
items.rationale: New robot foundation-model release that learns from human video and transfers skills to untrained robots; freshest, most novel item in the pool.

items.title: Perplexity Teammates bring autonomous AI agents to the Mac app
items.excerpt: Perplexity brings AI Teammates to Mac, letting Max subscribers delegate ongoing tasks to autonomous agents that work in the background.
items.rationale: New feature launch (background autonomous agents on Mac) distinct from the October local-workflows update; directly actionable for Mac users.

items.title: 1994 Jeep Cherokee owner hacks 32-year-old car with Claude AI to pass California smog tests
items.excerpt: A 1994 Jeep Cherokee owner used Claude and Codex plus about $15 of hardware (an Arduino) to reverse-engineer the car's ancient ECU for diagnostics and control and pass California smog tests.
items.rationale: Concrete maker story: AI coding agents plus a $15 Arduino reverse-engineer a car ECU; a different event from the earlier treadmill hack.

items.title: [CES 2027] 최고혁신상 60% 韓 차지…로봇·AI칩
items.excerpt: CES 2027 혁신상 발표에서 한국 기업이 최고혁신상의 60%를 차지했지만, 로봇과 AI 칩 부문 최고 영예는 중국·미국 기업이 가져갔다는 분석.
items.rationale: Official CES 2027 Innovation Award results with a robotics/AI-chip breakdown; a Korean-outlet view that previews the next big gadget cycle.

items.title: The Amazon Alexa Photo Frame made me cry — in a good way
items.excerpt: Tom's Guide reviews the Amazon Alexa Photo Frame, which uses AI to curate and present large photo libraries; best for Amazon Prime subscribers.
items.rationale: First review of a new AI-curated smart-home device; a different product from the Alexa Tablet 12 Pro already covered.

dedup.note: Dropped as duplicates of published gadgets stories: CNET Apple Watch Audio Intelligence hands-on (same watchOS 27.3 feature as MacRumors 11-04, no new release); Tom's Guide free AI smart-TV trick (same topic as TechCrunch 10-20); 9to5Google and Gizmodo Nothing AI gadget pieces (one cluster c4, both pre-launch commentary, no new action beyond The Verge 11-05 teaser). Timekettle earbuds review was already removed upstream. Not picked on merit: TechRadar robot-pet gift roundup and Engadget NPU explainer (evergreen), TechRadar AI teddy bear opinion piece, Tom's Hardware npu-driver (11-04, lower impact), and Tom's Guide UK smart-glasses ban (11-05 policy story that likely belongs to politics, so skipped to avoid a cross-section clash). Cross-section URL checks against published_urls.json politics and science found no clash for the picks. Outlets: 5 distinct (Gadgeteer, Digital Trends, Tom's Hardware, etnews, Tom's Guide).
